verdict.rationale: cubic ships several background automations that run without manual triggering: it auto-reviews every new PR once installed, runs codebase scans that 'deploy thousands of AI agents' across the repo, keeps an AI wiki current via a rolling PR, and can auto-approve clean PRs per policy — all autonomous, event-driven background processes.  missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable scheduling/cron-style automations beyond PR-triggered events, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that these background jobs run reliably unattended.
